stage1.impression: A clean, centred dark-studio hero with a nice soft wall glow and generous negative space, but it still reads as CG. The horn reads as liquid red chrome (a flat pink reflection half and black blobs) rather than tinted acrylic, the cabinet front is flatly lit so the internals look like salmon plastic blocks, and the floor is a near-mirror whose long crisp reflection says render more than 'faint gloss'.

blocking_9: Horn reads as tinted cast acrylic with a continuous graduated reflection and visible light through it, not as chrome with crushed black blobs (horn region crush_pct < 5, clip_pct < 1)
Cabinet shows clear front/side modelling (one face at least 1.5x the other) instead of equal flat brightness
Both vertical cabinet edges carry a coloured strip highlight; the right edge is currently dark
Floor reflection reads as a faint, softened gloss that fades within roughly a third of the product height, not a full mirror image
No white/chalky clipped streaks on red acrylic; edge highlights stay red-tinted

defects.what: Horn looks like red chrome: hard-edged flat pink reflection on lower-left half, black blob reflections of the dark set; 2.4% clipped, 14.6% crushed
Cabinet front and side nearly equal brightness (median 44.9 vs 47.8): flat, no modelling; inner boards read as opaque salmon plastic
Right vertical edge of cabinet is dark (median 9.7); strip-right is not tracing it, so the silhouette falls into the background on the right
Left vertical edge is a near-white streak (p95 240, G/B ~75) - chalky, loses the red tint
Floor reflection is a long, crisp near-mirror image of the whole cabinet including the woofer ring; reads as a render, not a faint gloss
Glow ends in a horizontal band at the sweep/floor transition behind the lower cabinet, reading as a soft horizon line cutting the product
Vignette asymmetric: left side 54% crushed vs right 27%; left falls to pure black
Upper wall carries a slight olive cast (R14 G13 B7) rather than neutral near-black

changes.problem: The horn reads as chrome: half of it mirrors a hard-edged panel, the rest mirrors the black set, and almost no light passes through it.

evidence.measured: lum_median 31.8 with p5 0 and p95 200; clip 2.36%, crush 14.61%; visually a flat pink half and black blobs

change.from: horn-front 1.2x0.6 m at [0.6,-2.2,1.6], strength 2.0; horn-back strength 6.0
change.to: horn-front 2.4x1.4 m at [0.2,-2.8,2.0], strength 1.1, ramp axis z at_m [1.2,2.6] values [0.1,1.0]; horn-back strength 10.0

changes.expected: One large graduated reflection wraps the horn's front from dark at the bottom to bright at the top, and the back panel shows red light through the acrylic, filling the black blobs with deep red.

changes.problem: The fill is brighter than the key, so the cabinet's front and side are equally bright and the object has no modelling.

evidence.measured: front median 44.9 (545-665) vs side median 47.8 (670-745); key irradiance 1.1 < fill 1.4

changes.expected: The front reads lit and the right side falls to a darker red, about 1.6:1, giving the box volume.

changes.problem: The right vertical edge has no strip highlight, so the right silhouette dissolves into the dark wall.
changes.expected: A thin red-tinted vertical line traces the right edge from floor to top, matching the left.

changes.problem: The floor is a near-mirror whose full, crisp reflection reads as CG rather than the brief's faint gloss.

evidence.measured: reflection p95 75 with the woofer ring and inner boards legible down to the frame bottom

changes.expected: A soft, dimmer red reflection that blurs and fades within about 80 px below the base.

changes.problem: The left strip clips to a near-white chalky streak that loses the acrylic's red.
changes.expected: The left edge stays a bright but red-tinted line.

changes.problem: The wall glow sits low behind the lower cabinet and ends in a horizon-like band, while the horn, the product's signature, sits on the dark.

evidence.measured: wall beside horn median 28.9; glow band at y 400-500 median ~44 dropping to ~11 by y 520

changes.expected: The glow centres behind the cabinet top and horn, fading more gradually into the floor, so the horn's silhouette separates from the wall.

changes.problem: The upper wall has a slight olive cast and the left side falls to pure black more than the right.

evidence.measured: R14 G13 B7; left zone crush 53.9% vs right 26.8%

changes.expected: The wall reads neutral graphite; blue median within 3 of red.

out_of_scope.request: Inner boards and blocks behind the front panel read as opaque salmon plastic; a darker or more neutral interior finish would let the acrylic read as tinted glass
out_of_scope.why: Changes the speaker's parts or colour, which are fixed

out_of_scope.request: The horn's surface is so glossy that it mirrors the set; a different finish might read more like acrylic
out_of_scope.why: The horn's material and shape belong to the product
